subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost adopt the same fixed 30-second WebSocket upgrade ceiling used by the Slack relay, accepting that upgrades taking longer than 30 seconds will reconnect rather than eventually succeed?
rationale: The code and proof establish that the timeout fixes an indefinite availability stall, but choosing the maximum tolerated upgrade latency is an operational policy decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Accept the 30-second ceiling
options.body: Land the bounded default because it matches the sibling channel precedent, restores reconnect progress, and avoids another configuration surface.

options.title: Request a different bound
options.body: Ask for a longer fixed timeout or deployment evidence before merge if supported Mattermost proxies are expected to exceed 30 seconds.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second ceiling
recommendation.body: Land the bounded default because it matches the sibling channel precedent, restores reconnect progress, and avoids another configuration surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing Mattermost reconnect lifecycle and error semantics appear to date to this person's merged work, making them the strongest available owner for the timeout policy choice.
